intro: The Grimtotem Compound is a fortified tribal settlement nestled in the central wilds of Feralas, just east of the elven ruins of Dire Maul. Occupied by the aggressive and insular Grimtotem clan, the encampment serves as a base for their mysterious and destructive operations in the region.

sections.t: A Bastion of the Black Tribe
p: Spanning two encampments east of Dire Maul, the Grimtotem Compound establishes a firm foothold for the Grimtotem clan in Feralas. Unlike the tauren aligned with Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff, the Grimtotem here operate independently and with hostility toward outsiders. In the southern half of the settlement, they keep captive sprite darters locked inside a large wooden cage for reasons of their own, while rogue gnolls stalk the fringes of their northern perimeter.
